opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search round-trip flights from Paris on Google Flights, search hotels on Booking, search a landmark tour on Viator, then save a summary note with prices.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, destination, and departure/return dates, search
Note the flight airline and price
Open Booking, enter destination and the same dates, search
Open the top hotel and note name and total price
Open Viator, search '<landmark> tour <city>', open top result, note title and price
Open Notes, create note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight ..., hotel ..., activity ...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages and save note
opportunities.description: For two Python packages, look up each on PyPI, open its repository to get stars, and write a comparison note with version, release date, stars and license.
steps: Search package A on PyPI and open its page
Note version, date, license; click repository link and note stars
Open Notes and add comparison note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature's support on caniuse and MDN, then compose an email to a person stating the supported browser version and MDN docs link.
steps: Search same feature on MDN and open the doc page
Type body with supported version and MDN URL
